results.detail: All compiler-sensitive visual/event calls are global
5 request.security() calls; below the common 40 unique-request tier
Uses na(x), avoiding invalid direct na comparisons
Each drawing cap is 400 (below Pine maximum 500)
Dynamic profile history is guarded below max_bars_back
Zone projection input is capped at 300 bars
4 columns x 19 rows; populated indices stay within 0..3 and 0..18
Six zone families each contain box/top/bottom/created/active arrays and an update call
Entry-zone, location, grade, cooldown, valid-risk and confirmed-bar guards present
BUY/SELL alertcondition plus dynamic BUY/SELL alert messages

limitation: Static validation only. The authoritative compile/runtime check remains TradingView Pine Editor because no official standalone Pine compiler is available in this environment.
